title: LLV-GBANKQ13: linear classical space and cube-root source growth

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one physical LLV-GBANKQ13 interpreter of proof.md executing the complete virtual.md program recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch fully charged work is O(2^((2/3)n^(2/3)log2n+2n^(2/3)(log2n)^(1/4))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index2/3. The exact GPS-Q13 width profile, global acquisition and fallback caps, all failed EXTRACT requests, pair searches, zero-level ownership pass-through, all-modulus decoders and finite branch are preserved. Every bank bit/address/operand operation, original coherent control, source SWAP, initialization and cleanup is charged. Virtual9.3 and the explicit eventual margin of proof.md Section6 absorb the complete fixed polynomial bank overhead into this exact envelope. All five claims concern this same physical implementation.

For this same physical LLV-GBANKQ13 algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated classical space is O(n) bits, with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. N, output, a fixed number of O(n)-bit staged operands, complete short addresses and finite controller code are included. All other signed labels, arrays, recursion/return contexts, cap and loop counters, arithmetic fields, generator and allocator metadata reside in the counted basis-qubit bank. There is no duplicate classical stack, n-entry register map or growing measurement transcript. This holds jointly with full-secret success and every other claim.

For this same physical LLV-GBANKQ13 algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak allocated quantum workspace is O(n^2) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Seven fixed regions of C*2^(2ceil(log2(n+2))) bits each, C=2^48, bound maximum virtual classical addresses; fixed O(n) logical quantum pools include all phases, roots, query/source/EXTRACT scratch. The direct even/odd wire map uses a wholly counted doubling paired prefix. All bank labels and metadata, unused padding, coherent registers, fair-bit and source scratch, allocation growth, failures and cleanup count. Complete physical addresses are charged. No coherent bank address, free QRAM or uncounted per-bit directory is introduced. The analytic pool bounds and slot reuse hold jointly with full-secret success and all claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANKQ13 algorithm, every N,s and EVERY branch, total acquired source copies are O(2^((1/2)n^(1/3))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/3. The CQ simulation executes exactly one physical request per virtual request, including each failed EXTRACT and fallback acquisition, and no others. Zero bank/padding preparations are counted time and quantum storage, not source copies. All rejects, discards and aborts remain included under the original global acquisition/fallback caps. Full virtual9.1 proves the literal main Qcap<=2^((1/2)n^(1/3)); finite lengths change only the outside constant. The unchanged full output law gives unconditional entire-secret success at least1-2^-8 jointly with all claims.

For this same physical LLV-GBANKQ13 algorithm/configuration, the guaranteed malformed-source fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. For every N>=2 and every secret, all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states and full-secret recovery succeeds with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 jointly with all four physical resource bounds. The bank simulation preserves the complete output and source law under this promise. Additional bank measurements may expose classical record bits under a different adaptive supplier model, for which no transfer or positive tolerance is claimed. Zero is not an impossibility assertion about greater robustness.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
